snippet.title: TELEGEDDON gameplay (DEMO in description!)
snippet.description:
Get the demo here:
https://eyesineverything.itch.io/telegeddon

Telegeddon is a genre-busting, TV-trashing action RPG with microgames for battles - think "Paper Mario meets Wario Ware" - solo developed by Luke Tarlowe AKA Thunder Dragon (Psycutlery, Psycho Waluigi) with musical contributions by DJ Yoshiman.

Want to follow development?  Join our Discord server here-
https://discord.gg/NS2jyKqR7H

We're also on Bluesky, sometimes-
https://bsky.app/profile/eyesineverything.bsky.social
